Title: Cognitive Services Speech SDK June 2018 update

Body.Content:
On May 7, 2018, we released the Cognitive Services Speech SDK as a preview. Today, we released the 0.4.0 update to the SDK.

The update adds audio input stream support and detailed output format support, along with bug fixes. For details, see the release notes.

To learn more and review sample code, see the documentation page.
